title: RNA seq of Epithelial cells treated with EGFR siRNA and cytokine_1
characteristics_ch1: cell type: lung epithelial cell | treatment: EGFR siRNA and cytokine | replication: 1
treatment_protocol_ch1: The mice were subjected to restraint using 50 mL tubes for 3 hours every 4 days.
data_processing: Illumina bcl2fastq2-v2.20.0 software used for basecalling. | Trimmomatic program is used to remove adapter sequences and bases with base quality lower than three from the ends. Also using sliding window method, bases of reads that does not qualify for window size 4, and mean quality 15 are trimmed. Afterwards, reads with length shorter than 36bp are dropped to produce trimmed data. | Sequenced reads were mapped to GRCh38 (hg38) whole genome by using HISAT2 version 2.1.0 with parameter -p 20 -dta --rna-strandness RF --novel-splicesite-outfile -x -1 -2 | Fragment Per Kilobase of exon per Megabase of library size (FPKM) were calculated by using StringTie version 2.1.3b, with parameter --rf -p 20 -l -o -G -A -C -e | Assembly: GRCh38 (hg38) | Supplementary files format and content: Read count values for each Sample
